# Markdown to AnnotatedString Generator

> Android library that converts Markdown into one Jetpack Compose AnnotatedString for a Text.

Use this when Markdown should become one styled string inside a Compose `Text`. The parser is CommonMark through JetBrains intellij-markdown. Links are a `"URL"` string annotation. Images are text placeholders. A `TextView`/`Spannable` library, or a renderer that emits a column of Compose nodes, fits a different layout.

Android `minSdk` 24. Maven coordinates: `com.sumup.markdown:annotatedstring-generator:0.1.1`.

```kotlin
val markdown = "Hello **world**! This is *italic* and `code`."
val flavour = CommonMarkFlavourDescriptor()
val parser = MarkdownParser(flavour)
val root = parser.buildMarkdownTreeFromString(markdown)
val annotatedString = AnnotatedStringGenerator(markdown, root, flavour).generateAnnotatedString()
```

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/sumup-oss/markdown-annotatedstring#readme): install snippets, Compose `Text` sample, and link-click handling
